_comment: Right-click context help for Refit's ship list, transcribed from ERICHELP::_refit_ship_popup_help_list (erichelp.cpp:118-126, s_help_box {help_id, x1, y1, x2, y2}), installed by Set_Refit_Ship_Popup_Help_List_ (erichelp.cpp:198-200, colrefit.cpp:98). First hit wins, the screen-wide 534 last, where the original keeps it. The design list's right clicks are the game's own text boxes (colrefit.cpp:562-590).
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py.
